criteria.name: Skill Pack Registry Matching
criteria.description: Every filled seat matches a registered skill pack; missing packs return 'blocked'; zero invented packs; spec_only packs explicitly labeled.

scale.3: 100% of seats matched to valid registry packs; spec_only packs labeled; missing packs properly blocked.
scale.2: Packs matched accurately, but minor missing note on spec_only status.
scale.1: One role matched to an incompatible or unverified skill pack.
scale.0: Invented skill pack created without registry backing.

criteria.name: Model Tier Assignment by Risk
criteria.description: Model tier strictly follows Handbook 6.1.2 risk table; dynamic resolution via live /models without hardcoded models.

scale.3: All agents assigned correct tier (high/medium/low) resolved dynamically to healthy live providers.
scale.2: Tier correct, but fallback resolution priority order slightly non-standard.
scale.1: Role assigned lower or higher tier without documented risk reasoning.
scale.0: Model names hardcoded or incorrect risk tier assigned without authorization.

criteria.name: Model Downgrade Logging and Quality Impact
criteria.description: Every model tier fallback/downgrade is explicitly logged in notes with expected effect on output quality per Handbook 22.4 rule 2.

scale.3: Every downgrade documented with original tier, fallback tier, and explicit quality effect statement.
scale.2: Downgrade noted with fallback model, but quality impact statement is brief.
scale.1: Downgrade occurred but missing expected quality impact.

criteria.name: Least Privilege Tool Allowances
criteria.description: Tools restricted strictly to Handbook 6.1.3 allowances. Zero run/shell/network tools on document roles (BA, PM, HR, Recruiter, Scrum, Designer).

scale.3: Strict least privilege: document roles get only read/write docs tools; developer/QA roles get specific scoped tools.
scale.2: Tools compliant, minor redundant read tool assigned.
scale.1: Document role holds an unnecessary read/write permission beyond docs/.
scale.0: Document role assigned shell, run, or git execution tools (Must-Not violation).

criteria.name: Filesystem Scope Sandboxing
criteria.description: Agent fs_scope is narrowed to exact role folder per Handbook 6.1.3 (docs/, own worktree, tests/, repo root).

scale.3: Every agent profile has strictly bounded fs_scope according with Handbook Table 6.1.3.
scale.2: Scoped correctly, minor relative path normalization variation.
scale.1: Scope broader than necessary (e.g. repo root given to document role).
scale.0: Unbounded root or system filesystem access.

criteria.name: Token Cap Derivation and Buffer
criteria.description: Token cap derived directly from estimate.json for that role + 20% rework buffer per Handbook 5.1.6; missing roles flagged.

scale.3: Exact derivation from estimate.json with 20% rework buffer; unestimated roles explicitly flagged.
scale.2: Token cap matches estimate, but 20% rework buffer rounded slightly.
scale.1: Token cap guessed rather than traced to estimate.json.
scale.0: Missing token caps or arbitrary numbers.

criteria.name: Org Chart Hierarchy and Management Links
criteria.description: reports_to links follow org chart 2.1: Devs, QA, Perf, DevOps report to tech-lead; others per chart.

scale.3: 100% of reports_to relationships accurately follow Handbook 2.1 hierarchy.
scale.2: Valid reporting line with minor naming discrepancy.
scale.1: Incorrect reporting relationship assigned (e.g. dev reporting to PM).
scale.0: Missing reports_to links or cyclic reporting lines.

criteria.name: Requisition Completion and Config Names
criteria.description: All HR requisitions (ROLE-##) are filled or flagged blocked; agent names sourced from config pool, never LLM hallucinated.

scale.3: All requisitions processed; agent names sourced cleanly from config pool; one row per filled seat in agents table.
scale.2: All requisitions filled, but name pool cycle repeated.
scale.1: One requisition left unhandled without blocked status.
scale.0: Requisitions dropped or agent names generated via LLM domain text.
